items.title: How Record Royalty Revenue Will Impact Texas Pacific Land Stock
items.summary: Texas Pacific Land reported record Q3 2026 results, with revenue of US$273.39 million, net income of US$167.37 million, and diluted EPS of US$2.42. The company also declared a quarterly dividend of US$0.60 per share for payment on December 15, 2026.
